audit.why: Pure artillery poke lane, hard early, one level-6 window, Vladimir only truly wins at 2+ items; TRICKY 7/10 fits 52.83% over 2084 games.

audit.whatIsWrong: Full-layer chart rows 3-6 disagreed with content win[] and the packet levelChart: row 3 said Xerath (should be Vladimir), rows 4-6 said blanket 'Skill' (should be Xerath, Xerath, Vladimir).
audit.why: Content win[] and packet levelChart agree exactly: X,X,X,V,X,X,V — the level-6 all-in is a window, not a takeover, and his Lost Chapter spike re-takes first item.
audit.corrected: Full sides and whys moved to match.

audit.why: Ability names all verified against the kit (Arcanopulse, Eye of Destruction, Shocking Orb, Rite of the Arcane, Mana Surge). Pool dodging Shocking Orb and R barrages is consistent with untargetability; no suspectNames.
Kit: E 13s scaling only to 11s, Q 9-5s at 80-120 mana, Vlad W 28s.

edits.before: - Xerath Shocking Orb (Stun): matchup-defining — His only CC — dodge the orb and his artillery never converts into a kill. It governs your forward steps. - W Sanguine Pool spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.
edits.after: - Shocking Orb (Stun) is 13s at rank 1 and barely improves (11s max) — his only CC; dodge it and the artillery never converts into a kill. - Arcanopulse costs 80-120 mana on a 9-5s cooldown — his dry spells are real windows. - Your 28s Pool spent on poke is a death you scheduled.

edits.before: Q the last-hit, E-charge as he steps to answer, release and walk — the trade costs him HP and pays yours.
edits.after: Shocking Orb is the one spell that turns his poke into a kill — Pool or sidestep it and the artillery only tickles.

edits.before: Pooling his poke and then eating the real engage at half HP with nothing — the pool is a combo-breaker, not a flinch reflex.
edits.after: A held E charge slows your dodge — at half HP inside his 1050-range Shocking Orb arc you are the stun he is fishing for.

edits.before: The crimson rush timing — Q empowers every third-ish cast and the sustain war starts tilting your way.
edits.after: Crimson Rush empowers every third-ish Q and your sustain now out-heals his mana-taxed poke — you stabilize.

edits.before: Hemoplague online — the all-in inverts: Q-E-R-E with ignite kills most mids who thought they were winning.
edits.after: Hemoplague gives you one all-in window, but outside it his R and 750-range poke still own the lane.

edits.before: Riftmaker timing: every trade heals more than it costs. Extended fights are now donations to your health bar.
edits.after: His Lost Chapter mana spike lands with your Riftmaker — the poke zone re-opens and he farms you off CS.

edits.before: Late Vlad is a raid boss: pool their engage, R their clump, and drain whatever stayed to argue.
edits.after: Late Vlad is a raid boss: pool his stun, dive the immobile artillery, drain whatever stays to argue.
